scales.heading: {{key}} {{scale}}
scales.intro: Every note of the scale across the neck. The pulsing ring marks the lowest root — the best place to start.

descriptions.major: The reference scale of Western music: bright and stable.
descriptions.minor: Same notes as the Aeolian mode: dark and melancholic.
descriptions.ionian: 1st mode of the major scale — identical to the major scale.
descriptions.dorian: 2nd mode: minor with a raised 6th. A funk, jazz and Latin staple.
descriptions.phrygian: 3rd mode: minor with a flat 2nd. Spanish and metal flavor.
descriptions.lydian: 4th mode: major with a raised 4th. Dreamy and floating.
descriptions.mixolydian: 5th mode: major with a flat 7th. Blues, rock and funk over dominant chords.
descriptions.locrian: 7th mode: flat 2nd and flat 5th. Tense; used over half-diminished chords.

player.hint: Tip: tap any fret to hear it.

metronome.gapHelp: Play some bars, then mute some: are you still on the beat when it comes back?
